shellCommands.command: ls app lib __agent_eval__ && cat package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json
rg -o "revalidateTag.*" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts | head -20; echo ---; rg -B5 -A15 "export declare function revalidateTag" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts
ls node_modules/next/*.d.ts; head -50 node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/types 2>/dev/null | head
(npm run start >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s localhost:3000 | grep -o "Sync latest catalog\|[A-Za-z]*" | sort -u

ACTION_ID=$(curl -s localhost:3000 | grep -o '"\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | head -1 | tr -d '"'); curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST localhost:3000 -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID"; sleep 3; grep -i "error\|revalidat" /tmp/next.log | head -5; pkill -f "next start" || true
(npm run start >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && HTML=$(curl -s localhost:3000) && echo "$HTML" | grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' | sort -u

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST localhost:3000 -H "Next-Action: 004e37a1c433e377383fd1fec0de880f2862d0c190" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data-raw '[]'; sleep 3; grep -i "error" /tmp/next.log | head; echo "---done---"; pkill -f "next start" || true
